export_module_to_exported_program: export a PyTorch nn.Module to an ExportedProgram using _export with example inputs and constraints
trace_callable_to_fx_graph: trace a callable function to a torch.fx.GraphModule in torch IR using _export_to_torch_ir
configure_export_dynamo_settings: configure ExportDynamoConfig to control Dynamo export behavior like allowing RNN tracing
restore_traced_module_state_dict: restore the state dict of a traced GraphModule to match the original nn.Module parameters
map_param_buffer_names: map parameter and buffer names between an original module and its traced counterpart
